'''Frocking''' was a slang that referred to the sport of racing through the streets of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], and yanking back the hoods [[Clothing/Legends|worn]] by [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], one of Tatooine's native [[Species/Legends|species]]. Mos Eisley's street urchins enjoyed the activity.<ref name="SWTSE" /> [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] before [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates {{Film|IV}}, which includes the [[Death/Legends|death]] of [[Greedo/Legends|Greedo]], to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]]. ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'' establishes that Greedo was alive [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] and [[Falk (criminal)|Falk]] frocked [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]], placing the event years before 0 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Falk (criminal)|Falk]] and [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] male [[Doda Bodonawieedo/Legends|Doda Bodonawieedo]] engaged in frocking during their youthful [[Standard day/Legends|days]].<ref name="SWTSE" /> By that year,<ref name="Date note">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Nebit}} shows a film still of the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit]] from {{Film|IV}}, mentioning Nebit hated being frocked by the [[in-universe]] [[Time/Legends|time]] of the image. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of that film to [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].</ref> the Jawa [[Nebit/Legends|Nebit]] hated being frocked.<ref name="Nebit">{{CCG|set=Special Edition Limited|cardname=Nebit}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Frocking was first mentioned in [[1997]]'s ''[[Star Wars Trilogy Sourcebook, Special Edition]]'', a supplement for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="SWTSE" />
